needPlan.q: Do I need a plan to apply for jobs?
needPlan.a: No. Searching, saving and applying for jobs is free for everyone.

howPay.q: How do I pay for a plan?
howPay.a: Paid plans renew automatically every month through PayPal. You can cancel anytime from your profile, and access continues until the end of the period you already paid for.

cancel.a: Your subscription stays active until the current billing period ends, then it won't renew. You can subscribe again at any time.

expires.q: What happens when a subscription expires?
expires.a: You lose that plan's paid features. We notify you a few days before it expires, and again once it has.

escrow.q: Is the escrow fee included in my plan?
escrow.a: No. The 10% escrow fee applies only when a freelance milestone is released, on every plan.
